a.lede: Finnish authorities say they cannot conduct a proper environmental assessment after the site has already been changed.
a.title: Finland orders Google to stop work on two AI data centers over alleged deforestation

b.lede: Google’s latest data center construction project in Finland is being investigated after the company representing the search giant reportedly cleared over 300 hectares of forest before obtaining a mandatory environmental impact assessment.
b.title: Google AI data center project investigated after 420 football fields of Finnish forest demolished
